title.value: Compile deductions and Schedule C with Claude Code

introduction.value: Claude Code gathered charitable contributions and itemized deductions from sheets, email and statements and built a Schedule C; some categorizing stayed manual.

method.value: Chris Blattman built Claude Code skills: one searches Gmail for tax documents, downloads attachments, pulls out key figures and tracks what's missing. Another compiles deductions from a charitable-giving Google Sheet, email receipts and card statements into spreadsheets ready for tax software. It also built a Schedule C for his consulting income. He eyeballed card statements to flag medical and childcare charges, and entered the figures into tax software himself.

outcome.value: He says the work took about three hours, versus roughly $1,000 for an accountant. Sorting, filtering and CSV parsing went well, but medical and childcare categorizing stayed manual.

notes.value: Read the privacy page first: local file contents are sent to Anthropic's API when Claude reads them, so never paste SSNs or bank account numbers.

source_text.body:
Compile deductions and Schedule C with Claude Code
Claude Code gathered charitable contributions and itemized deductions from sheets, email and statements and built a Schedule C; some categorizing stayed manual.
Done with
CC
Claude Code
What they did
Chris Blattman built Claude Code skills: one searches Gmail for tax documents, downloads attachments, pulls out key figures and tracks what's missing. Another compiles deductions from a charitable-giving Google Sheet, email receipts and card statements into spreadsheets ready for tax software. It also built a Schedule C for his consulting income. He eyeballed card statements to flag medical and childcare charges, and entered the figures into tax software himself.
How it went
He says the work took about three hours, versus roughly $1,000 for an accountant. Sorting, filtering and CSV parsing went well, but medical and childcare categorizing stayed manual.
Worth knowing
Read the privacy page first: local file contents are sent to Anthropic's API when Claude reads them, so never paste SSNs or bank account numbers.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
Look through [spreadsheets, email export folder, and statements folder] for [year] and compile my charitable contributions and other itemized deductions into one spreadsheet with date, payee, amount, and source file. Then draft a Schedule C from my business income and expenses, marking any lines you couldn't categorize with confidence. Finish when I have both files and a list of open questions for me to resolve.
Original source: https://claudeblattman.com/tax-workflow/
source_text.scope: Captured case text; external linked articles and HTML excluded.

introduction.en: A researcher used Claude Code to assemble tax-preparation inputs from scattered records.
introduction.zh: 一位研究者用 Claude Code 将分散资料汇总为报税准备材料。

method.en: Chris Blattman built Claude Code skills to find Gmail tax attachments, extract figures and track missing documents. A second workflow reconciled donations, receipts and card statements.
method.zh: Chris Blattman自建Claude Code技能，搜集Gmail税务附件、提取数字并追踪缺件；另一流程整合捐赠表、收据和信用卡账单。

method.en: Outputs included deduction spreadsheets and Schedule C for consulting income. He manually identified medical and childcare items and entered the final tax software himself.
method.zh: 输出包括扣除项目表和咨询收入Schedule C；医疗、托育项目由本人识别，最终报税软件也由本人录入。

outcome.en: He describes about three hours of work compared with an approximately $1,000 accountant option; sorting, filtering and CSV handling worked better than the remaining manual categories.
outcome.zh: 他描述用时约三小时，并与约1,000美元会计服务作比较；排序、筛选和CSV处理较顺利，部分分类仍需人工。

notes.en: The source advises checking privacy terms: reading local files may send their contents to Anthropic. It specifically cautions against including SSNs or bank-account numbers.
notes.zh: 源站要求先查隐私说明：读取本地文件可能将内容发送给Anthropic，特别提醒不要纳入社保号或银行账号。
